March 1986
National High-Tech R&D Program (863 Program)
CPC Central Committee & State Council (approved); State Science and Technology Commission (implemented)

Included "electric vehicles" in the national high-tech R&D program, marking the official start of China's NEV technology R&D. The 863 Program selected 7 fields including biotechnology, aerospace, IT, laser, automation, energy, and new materials. The automation field included intelligent robots and electric vehicles. [further verification needed on specific project codes]
MOST official website; "863 Program Management Measures"
"Eighth Five-Year" Science & Technology Key Project — Electric Vehicle Key Technologies
State Planning Commission, State Science and Technology Commission

Listed electric vehicle key technologies as a national S&T key project during the "Eighth Five-Year Plan" period, focusing on basic technologies such as EV complete vehicle technology and drive motor systems.
"History of China's Electric Vehicle Development"; MOST public records
September 2001
"Tenth Five-Year" National S&T Key Project — "Electric Vehicle Major Special Project"
Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST)

Formally established the "Electric Vehicle Major Special Project" with ≈8.8 billion yuan investment (≈24 billion yuan including local and enterprise matching funds). Established the "Three Verticals, Three Horizontals" R&D framework (3 verticals: BEV, HEV, FCV; 3 horizontals: motor, battery, electronic control).
MOST "10th Five-Year EV Special Project Acceptance Report"; "National Medium- and Long-Term S&T Development Plan (2006-2020)"
May 2004
Automotive Industry Development Policy
National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC, Order No. 8)

For the first time in national auto industry policy, encouraged development of energy-efficient and environmentally friendly vehicles and NEVs. Explicitly supported R&D and industrialization of EVs, HEVs, and other new powertrains.
NDRC Order No. 8 (2004)
February 2006
National Medium- and Long-Term S&T Development Plan (2006-2020)
State Council (Guo Fa [2006] No. 6)
Listed "low-energy and new energy vehicles" and "hydrogen and fuel cell technology" as priority themes and frontier technologies. Designated NEVs as a key field of national strategic demand.
State Council Guo Fa [2006] No. 6
November 2007
NEV Production Access Management Rules
National Development and Reform Commission (Announcement 2007 No. 72)

First established China's NEV production enterprise and product access management system. Defined the scope of NEVs (BEV, HEV, FCV, etc.). Standardized enterprise production qualification and product access conditions.
NDRC Announcement 2007 No. 72
January 2009
Notice on Launching Energy-Efficient and NEV Demonstration & Promotion Pilot (EV1000 / "Ten Cities, Thousand Vehicles" Program)
Ministry of Finance, MOST (Cai Jian [2009] No. 6)

Launched energy-efficient and NEV demonstration promotion pilots in 13 cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing. Planned to promote 1,000+ NEVs in public service areas within 3 years. Central finance provided one-time purchase subsidies. First batch of 13 cities began in February 2009.
Cai Jian [2009] No. 6; MOF official website
June 2009
"Ten Cities, Thousand Vehicles" Program Supplemental Notice
Ministry of Finance, MOST
Expanded pilot cities from 13 to 20. Increased NEV promotion intensity in public transport, taxi, government, and sanitation sectors.
MOF, MOST public documents
May 2010
Notice on Launching Private Purchase of NEV Subsidy Pilot
MOF, MOST, MIIT, NDRC (Cai Jian [2010] No. 230)
Launched private purchase NEV subsidy pilots in Shanghai, Changchun, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Hefei. Provided one-time subsidies for BEVs and PHEVs (max 60,000 yuan/vehicle).
Cai Jian [2010] No. 230
October 2011
Notice on Further Improving Energy-Saving and NEV Demonstration & Promotion Pilot Work
MOF, MOST, MIIT, NDRC
Expanded pilot cities to 25. Specified charging infrastructure support policies and NEV promotion targets. Required each pilot city to develop demonstration promotion plans.
Four-ministry joint public document
April 2012
Energy-Saving and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020)
State Council (Guo Fa [2012] No. 22)

First national-level NEV industry development plan: target of 500,000 cumulative BEV+PHEV production & sales by 2015; 2 million annual capacity and 5+ million cumulative by 2020. Established "pure electric drive" as the primary strategic direction for China's automotive industry transformation.
State Council Guo Fa [2012] No. 22; gov.cn
July 2014
Announcement on Exempting NEVs from Vehicle Purchase Tax
MOF, SAT, MIIT (Announcement 2014 No. 53)

From Sept 1, 2014 to Dec 31, 2017, NEV purchases exempted from vehicle purchase tax. First batch of "NEV Models Exempt from Vehicle Purchase Tax" catalog published simultaneously. Policy was subsequently extended multiple times.
MOF, SAT, MIIT Announcement 2014 No. 53
July 2014
Guiding Opinions on Accelerating NEV Promotion and Application
State Council General Office (Guo Ban Fa [2014] No. 35)

Required local governments to eliminate protectionism, implement charging facility construction responsibilities, and improve comprehensive policy system for NEV promotion. Specified 25 measures across 6 areas.
Guo Ban Fa [2014] No. 35
November 2014
Notice on Rewards for NEV Charging Facility Construction
MOF, MOST, MIIT, NDRC (Cai Jian [2014] No. 692)
Provided central finance rewards to cities with significant NEV promotion and outstanding charging facility construction. Rewards tiered by promotion volume.
Cai Jian [2014] No. 692
May 2015
"Made in China 2025"
State Council (Guo Fa [2015] No. 28)

Listed "energy-saving and new energy vehicles" as one of 10 key sectors. Targeted NEV complete vehicle and core component technology reaching international advanced levels by 2025. Domestic brand NEV market share target of 80%+ by 2025. "Intelligent connected vehicles" (ICVs) mentioned for first time in national strategy.
State Council Guo Fa [2015] No. 28; gov.cn
April 2015
2016-2020 NEV Promotion and Application Financial Support Policy
MOF, MOST, MIIT, NDRC (Cai Jian [2015] No. 134)
Specified 2016-2020 NEV subsidy standards and phase-down mechanism: subsidies reduced 20% in 2017-2018 and 40% in 2019-2020 vs 2016 baseline. Differentiated subsidies for BEV, PHEV, and FCV.
Cai Jian [2015] No. 134
December 2016
Notice on Adjusting NEV Promotion and Application Financial Subsidy Policies
MOF, MOST, MIIT, NDRC (Cai Jian [2016] No. 958)

Following subsidy fraud investigation ("fraud compensation"), substantially revised policies: raised subsidy thresholds (e.g., BEV range ≥100km), reduced amounts, established national + local subsidy cap (≤50% of national subsidy), and introduced non-personal user mileage requirement (30,000 km).
Cai Jian [2016] No. 958
June 2017
Parallel Management Measures for Corporate Average Fuel Consumption and New Energy Vehicle Credits (Dual-Credit Policy)
MIIT, MOF, MOFCOM, GAC, AQSIQ (Order No. 44)

First established dual-credit parallel management mechanism (CAFC + NEV credits). Required passenger vehicle enterprises to meet NEV credit ratios from 2019 (10% in 2019, 12% in 2020). Non-compliant enterprises must purchase credits or face penalties. Viewed as long-term mechanism after subsidy phase-down.
MIIT Order No. 44
December 2017
Announcement on Extending NEV Vehicle Purchase Tax Exemption
MOF, SAT, MIIT, MOST (2017 No. 172 Announcement)
Extended NEV vehicle purchase tax exemption to Dec 31, 2020. [further verification needed on exact announcement number]
MOF Announcement 2017 No. 172
February 2018
Notice on Adjusting and Improving NEV Promotion Financial Subsidy Policies
MOF, MIIT, MOST, NDRC (Cai Jian [2018] No. 18)

Further raised subsidy thresholds: BEV minimum range requirement increased to 150 km, battery energy density requirement ≥120 Wh/kg. General subsidy reduction with differentiated "supporting the strong" approach.
Cai Jian [2018] No. 18
March 2018
Management Specification for Intelligent Connected Vehicle Road Testing (Trial)
MIIT, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Transport

First national-level regulation for ICV (autonomous driving) public road testing. Specified testing entities, vehicles, driver conditions, and application procedures. Provided unified legal framework for autonomous driving road tests nationwide.
MIIT official website; MIIT Lian Zhuang [2018] No. 66
March 2019
Notice on Further Improving NEV Promotion Financial Subsidy Policies
MOF, MIIT, MOST, NDRC (Cai Jian [2019] No. 138)

Major phase-down: BEV subsidy amounts reduced by ≈50-60% vs 2018. Range threshold raised to 250 km (from 150 km). Local subsidies (local purchase subsidies) eliminated. Vehicles under 250 km range no longer eligible after transition period. "Weaning period" began.
Cai Jian [2019] No. 138
May 2019
Pilot Plan for Supporting NEV Power Battery Recycling
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Launched NEV power battery recycling pilots in 17 regions nationwide. Established battery coding traceability management platform. Promoted echelon utilization and recycling industry system development.
MIIT official website; MIIT Jie Han [2018] No. 68 [further verification needed on document number]
April 2020
Notice on Improving NEV Promotion Financial Subsidy Policies
MOF, MIIT, MOST, NDRC (Cai Jian [2020] No. 86)

Extended NEV subsidy policy to end of 2022 (originally scheduled to end in 2020). Established dedicated "battery swap" subsidy model. Subsidy standards phased down 10%, 20%, 30% annually in 2020-2022. Continued to raise vehicle energy consumption and battery energy density requirements.
Cai Jian [2020] No. 86
October 2020
New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2021-2035)
State Council General Office (Guo Ban Fa [2020] No. 39)

Target: NEV sales reach ~20% of total new vehicle sales by 2025; BEVs become mainstream by 2035. Deepened "Three Verticals, Three Horizontals" R&D framework. Promoted electrification, connectivity, and intelligentization integration. Targeted commercialization of highly autonomous vehicles in limited areas and specific scenarios by 2025. Specified full electrification goals for public sector vehicles.
Guo Ban Fa [2020] No. 39; gov.cn
November 2020
New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2021-2035) (Formal Issuance)
State Council General Office

Clarified five key tasks: enhancing technological innovation capability, building a new industrial ecosystem, promoting integrated industrial development, improving the infrastructure system, and deepening opening-up and cooperation. Encouraged power battery recycling and hydrogen fuel cell vehicle development.
Guo Ban Fa [2020] No. 39
February 2021
National Comprehensive Three-Dimensional Transport Network Planning Outline
CPC Central Committee, State Council

Proposed coordinated layout of transportation and information infrastructure. Promoted vehicle-road coordination and autonomous driving technology development. Emphasized smart transportation and NEV coordinated development.
CPC Central Committee, State Council public document
March 2021
14th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and 2035 Vision Targets
National People's Congress

Defined strategic emerging industries focusing on NEVs. Promoted autonomous driving and connected vehicle key technology research. Cultivated and expanded intelligent connected vehicles as new growth drivers.
NPC resolution; gov.cn
April 2021
ICV Production Enterprise and Product Access Management Guidelines (Trial)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Specified ICV production enterprise and product access conditions. Required enterprises to have functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, and data security assurance capabilities. Regulated L3/L4 autonomous driving product access application procedures. [further verification needed on document number]
MIIT Equipment Industry Division I public document
April 2021
Notice on Organizing NEV Battery Swap Mode Application Pilot
MIIT, National Energy Administration

Launched NEV battery swap mode application pilot. Formally designated 8 comprehensive application cities (Beijing, Nanjing, Wuhan, Sanya, Chongqing, Changchun, Hefei, Jinan) and 3 heavy-truck featured cities (Yibin, Tangshan, Baotou) in October 2021.
MIIT General Office public document (October 2021)
May 2021
Guiding Opinions on Further Strengthening NEV Safety System Construction (Draft for Comments)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Strengthened requirements for NEV complete vehicle and power battery product safety design, production consistency management, operational monitoring, and accident emergency response. [further verification needed on final release document number and date]
MIIT public consultation document
July 2021
Management Specification for ICV Road Testing and Demonstration Application (Trial)
MIIT, MPS, MOT

Revised from 2018 "ICV Road Testing Management Specification." Expanded scope to include passenger and freight demonstration applications and highway testing. Further refined testing and demonstration management requirements.
MIIT official website; MIIT Lian Zhuang [2021] No. 97
August 2021
Opinions on Strengthening ICV Production Enterprise and Product Access Management
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Required ICV production enterprises to establish cybersecurity, data security, and functional safety assurance capabilities. Regulated OTA (over-the-air) update management. Strengthened autonomous driving function product safety management, specifying L3+ autonomous driving system access requirements.
MIIT official website; MIIT Zhuang [2021] No. 11 [further verification needed]
October 2021
Opinions on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Philosophy for Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality
CPC Central Committee, State Council

Clarified accelerating low-carbon transportation system construction. Actively expanding new/clean energy applications in transportation. Promoting NEVs and gradually reducing traditional fuel vehicle share in new vehicle production, sales, and fleet.
CPC Central Committee, State Council public document
October 2021
Action Plan for Carbon Peaking by 2030
State Council (Guo Fa [2021] No. 23)

Targeted ~40% of new vehicles to be new/clean energy by 2030. Vigorously promoted NEVs with gradual reduction of traditional fuel vehicle share in new vehicle production/sales. Orderly promoted charging infrastructure construction.
Guo Fa [2021] No. 23
December 2021
NEV Commercial Insurance Exclusive Clauses (Trial)
China Insurance行业协会 (Insurance Association of China)

Released exclusive insurance product clauses for NEVs addressing "three-electric" system (battery, motor, electronic control) specific risks, separating from traditional fuel vehicle insurance products. NEV insurance trading platform launched on December 27, 2021.
Insurance Association of China; Shanghai Insurance Exchange
December 2021
Guiding Opinions on Strengthening EV Charging Facility Construction (2021 Edition)
NDRC, NEA, MIIT, et al. (multiple ministries)

Proposed building moderately advanced, balanced, and smart charging infrastructure system by end of "14th Five-Year" period, meeting 20+ million EV charging demand. Promoted residential community and urban-rural charging network coverage.
NDRC, NEA public document
January 2022
Notice on 2022 NEV Promotion Financial Subsidy Policy
MOF, MIIT, MOST, NDRC (Cai Jian [2021] No. 465)
2022 NEV subsidy standards phased down 30% from 2021. Clarified that NEVs registered after Dec 31, 2022 would no longer receive central financial subsidies (national subsidy termination).
Cai Jian [2021] No. 465
March 2022
"14th Five-Year Plan" for Modern Energy System
NDRC, NEA
Promoted NEV-grid interactive energy management (V2G). Advanced EV charging facility network construction. Promoted hydrogen technology development and FCV demonstration applications.
NDRC, NEA public document (Fa Gai Neng Yuan [2022] No. 210)
April 2022
Guiding Opinions on Further Strengthening NEV Enterprise Safety System Construction
MIIT, MPS, MOT, MEM, SAMR

Five-ministry joint document. Comprehensively improved NEV safety levels covering safety management mechanisms, product quality (including power batteries), operational monitoring platform effectiveness, safety incident response, etc.
MIIT official website (April 8, 2022)
June 2022
Notice on 2022 NEV "Go to the Countryside" Campaign
MIIT, MARA, MOFCOM, NEA
Continued organizing NEV "go to the countryside" campaign. Encouraged local governments to introduce supporting policies for rural areas. Guided rural residents toward green mobility.
MIIT Equipment Industry Division I public document
July 2022
Several Measures on Further Expanding Auto Consumption
MOFCOM and 16 other ministries

Proposed supporting NEV consumption. Researching extension of NEV vehicle purchase tax exemption policy beyond expiration. Deepening NEV "go to the countryside" and trade-in programs. Accelerating charging infrastructure construction.
MOFCOM public document
September 2022
Announcement on Extending NEV Vehicle Purchase Tax Exemption Policy
MOF, SAT, MIIT (2022 No. 21 Announcement)

Extended NEV vehicle purchase tax exemption to Dec 31, 2023. NEVs purchased between Jan 1, 2023 and Dec 31, 2023 exempted from vehicle purchase tax. [further verification needed on announcement number]
MOF, SAT, MIIT Announcement
November 2022
Notice on Launching Public Sector Vehicle Full Electrification Pilot Zones
MIIT, MOT, NDRC, et al.

Launched public sector full electrification pilots in eligible cities covering buses, taxis, logistics, sanitation, postal services. Quantitative target: NEV ratio ≥80% in pilot zone public sector vehicles. [further verification needed on exact issuance date]
MIIT public document
November 2022
ICV Access and Road Operation Pilot Work Guidelines (Draft for Comments)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Explored establishment of product access and road operation pilot management systems for L3/L4 ICVs. Provided policy framework for autonomous driving commercial application. [further verification needed on final version]
MIIT Equipment Industry Division I public consultation
January 2023
Notice on Several Measures to Further Vitalize Auto Circulation and Expand Auto Consumption
MOFCOM and 16 other ministries
Continued to support NEV purchases and use. Promoted cross-regional free circulation of NEVs. Encouraged scrapping and upgrading of old vehicles and NEV replacement programs.
MOFCOM public document
June 2023
Announcement on Extending and Optimizing NEV Vehicle Purchase Tax Reduction/Exemption Policy
MOF, SAT, MIIT (2023 No. 10 Announcement)
New policy: NEVs purchased Jan 1, 2024 - Dec 31, 2025 exempt from vehicle purchase tax (cap of 30,000 yuan/vehicle); Jan 1, 2026 - Dec 31, 2027 half-rated purchase tax (cap of 15,000 yuan/vehicle).
MOF, SAT, MIIT Announcement 2023 No. 10
June 2023
Guiding Opinions on Further Building a High-Quality Charging Infrastructure System
State Council General Office (Guo Ban Fa [2023] No. 19)

By 2030, basically build a widespread, appropriately sized, well-structured, and fully functional high-quality charging infrastructure system. Proposed convenient and efficient intercity and urban charging networks, plus effective rural area coverage.
Guo Ban Fa [2023] No. 19
September 2023
Announcement on Adjusting Technical Requirements for NEV Products Eligible for Vehicle Purchase Tax Reduction/Exemption
MIIT, MOF, SAT (2023 No. 32 Announcement)

Adjusted and refined technical conditions for NEVs eligible for vehicle purchase tax reduction/exemption. Raised requirements for vehicle energy consumption, driving range, power battery system energy density, etc.
MIIT, MOF, SAT Announcement 2023 No. 32
November 2023
Notice on Launching ICV Access and Road Operation Pilot Work
MIIT, MPS, MOHURD, MOT (MIIT Lian Tong Zhuang [2023] No. 217)

Formally launched L3/L4 ICV access and road operation pilot. Specified pilot application procedures, access conditions, user entities, road operation management details. First time allowing L3/L4 autonomous passenger cars and trucks on public roads.
MIIT Lian Tong Zhuang [2023] No. 217
December 2023
Announcement on Adjusting Technical Requirements for NEV Products Eligible for Vehicle Purchase Tax Reduction/Exemption
MIIT, MOF, SAT (2023 No. 32 Announcement)

Effective Jan 1, 2024, models applying for inclusion in "NEV Vehicle Purchase Tax Reduction/Exemption Catalog" must meet adjusted technical requirements including driving range and battery energy density indicators.
MIIT, MOF, SAT Announcement 2023 No. 32
January 2024
Notice on Organizing 2024 NEV "Go to the Countryside" Campaign
MIIT, NDRC, MARA, MOFCOM, NEA
Continued 2024 NEV "go to the countryside" campaign. Selected models suitable for rural markets. Increased promotional efforts. Improved rural charging facility construction.
MIIT public document
March 2024
Guiding Opinions on Accelerating Green Development of the Manufacturing Industry
MIIT and 6 other ministries
Promoted green development of the NEV industry chain, including power battery recycling system construction and vehicle manufacturing carbon footprint management.
MIIT public document
May 2024
Notice on Launching ICV "Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integration" Application Pilot
MIIT, MPS, MNR, MOHURD, MOT
Selected cities nationwide for "Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integration" application pilot. Promoted C-V2X technology large-scale application. Built city-level vehicle-road-cloud integrated infrastructure.
MIIT et al. (5 ministries) public document (May 2024)
July 2024
Notice on Further Improving NEV Power Battery Recycling
MIIT, et al.
Strengthened power battery recycling industry standardization. Advanced power battery full lifecycle traceability management system. Standardized recycling service network construction.
MIIT Energy Conservation and Comprehensive Utilization Division public document
September 2024
Opinions on Improving Urban Charging and Battery Swap Facility Construction
NEA, MOHURD, MOT, et al.
Accelerated charging/battery swap facility construction in residential communities, office buildings, and commercial areas. Promoted charging pile integration into urban infrastructure planning.
NEA public document
November 2024
Several Policy Measures on Further Consolidating and Enhancing NEV Industry Advantages
MIIT, et al.

Introduced a series of measures in areas including technological innovation, standards system building, industry chain coordination, and brand development to consolidate China's leading position in the NEV industry. [further verification needed on formal document number]
MIIT public document
December 2024
Notice on 2025 NEV Promotion Policy
MOF, MIIT, MOST, NDRC

Clarified 2025 NEV subsidy policy adjustments. From January 2024, subsidies substantially reduced; post-2025 primarily non-direct subsidy methods: tax exemption/reduction, traffic right prioritization, charging discounts, etc. [further verification needed on specific document content and number]
Relevant ministry public documents; industry reports
January 2025
2025 Action Plan for Promoting High-Quality NEV Industry Development
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
Proposed 2025 NEV sales share targets and core technology breakthrough directions. Promoted key areas such as vehicle-grade chips and operating systems.
MIIT press conference information (January 2025)
February 2025
Power Battery Recycling Management Measures (Revised Edition)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Strengthened the extended producer responsibility system for power batteries. Established a unified and standardized battery recycling network and traceability management system. [further verification needed on final document number]
MIIT public document
April 2025
ICV Standard System (2025 Edition)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

Updated ICV standard system roadmap covering functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, data security, human-machine interaction, and autonomous driving test and evaluation standards. [further verification needed on release version]
MIIT Equipment Industry Division I public document
August 2025
Opinions on Measures to Expand NEV Exports
MOFCOM, MIIT, GAC, et al.
Promoted facilitation of NEV and power battery exports. Supported enterprises in establishing overseas production and after-sales service networks. Addressed international trade barriers.
MOFCOM public document
September 2025
Announcement on Adjusting Technical Requirements for Energy-Saving and NEV Products Eligible for Vehicle/Vessel Tax Reduction
MIIT, MOF, SAT (2025 No. 25 Announcement)
Adjusted technical requirements for energy-saving and NEV products eligible for vehicle/vessel tax reduction. Effective January 1, 2026.
MIIT, MOF, SAT Announcement 2025 No. 25
October 2025
NEV Operation Safety Inspection Standards
SAMR, MIIT, MOT

Developed specialized periodic inspection standards and procedures targeting the unique safety characteristics of NEVs, particularly the "three-electric" system (battery, motor, electronic control). [further verification needed on final release]
SAMR, MIIT public document
December 2025
ICV Testing and Demonstration Management Measures (Revised)
MIIT, MPS, MOT
Revised and improved ICV testing and demonstration management regulations based on recent "Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integration" pilot experience. Expanded testing and demonstration area scope.
MIIT, MPS, MOT public document
January 2026
Implementation Measures for 2026-2027 NEV Vehicle Purchase Tax Half-Rate Policy
MOF, SAT, MIIT
Based on 2023 No. 10 Announcement: Jan 1, 2026 - Dec 31, 2027, NEVs subject to half-rate vehicle purchase tax (tax reduction cap of 15,000 yuan/vehicle). Specified implementation details.
MOF, SAT, MIIT Announcement
January 2026
Interim Measures for NEV Waste Power Battery Recycling and Comprehensive Utilization
MIIT and 5 other ministries

Following "full-channel, full-chain, full-lifecycle" management approach. Effective April 1, 2026. Established full-process regulatory system for waste battery collection, transportation, storage, dismantling, and recycling.
MIIT et al. (6 ministries) public document (January 16, 2026)
February 2026
Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integration Standard System Construction Guide
MIIT, Standardization Administration of China
Established vehicle-road-cloud integration standard system covering perception, communication, computing, control, and security domains. Guided subsequent technical standard development.
MIIT, SAC public document
March 2026
Notice on Expanding Hydrogen FCV Demonstration Application
MIIT, NDRC, NEA
Expanded FCV demonstration city cluster scope and application areas beyond initial 5 clusters (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Shanghai, Guangdong, Hebei, Henan).
MIIT et al. public document
April 2026
NEV Waste Power Battery Recycling and Comprehensive Utilization Management Interim Measures Take Effect
MIIT and 5 other ministries

Formally effective from April 1, 2026. Full lifecycle traceability management for waste power batteries covering recycling network construction, echelon utilization, recycling, and environmental supervision.
MIIT et al. (6 ministries) public document
